paragraphs: NexPoint Real Estate Finance, Inc. (the "Company", "we", "our", "NREF") is a commercial mortgage REIT incorporated in Maryland on June 7, 2019 that has elected to be taxed as a REIT under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the "Code"). The Company is focused on originating, structuring and investing in first-lien mortgage loans ("senior loans"), mezzanine loans, preferred equity, convertible notes, multifamily properties and common equity investments, as well as multifamily and single-family rental ("SFR") commercial mortgage backed securities securitizations ("CMBS securitizations"), promissory notes, revolving credit facilities and stock warrants, or our target assets. We primarily focus on investments in real estate sectors where our senior management team has operating expertise, including in the multifamily, SFR, self-storage, industrial and life science sectors predominantly in the top 50 metropolitan statistical areas ("MSAs"). The Company also lends to redevelopment and development projects in special situations where there is strong sponsorship and clear and visible cost basis detachment points and exit options. Substantially all of the Company's business is conducted through NexPoint Real Estate Finance Operating Partnership, L.P. (the "OP"), the Company's operating partnership. As of December 31, 2025, the Company held approximately 86.56% of the common limited partnership units in the OP ("OP Units") which represents 100% of the Class A OP Units, and the OP owned all of the common limited partnership units ("SubOP Units") of its three subsidiary partnerships (collectively, the "Subsidiary OPs") (see Note 13 to our consolidated financial statements).

The OP also directly owns all of the membership interests of a limited liability company (the "Mezz LLC") through which it owns a portfolio of mezzanine loans, as further discussed below. NexPoint Real Estate Finance OP GP, LLC (the "OP GP") is the sole general partner of the OP. In addition to OP Units, the Company holds all 2,000,000 of the issued and outstanding 8.50% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Units (liquidation preference $25.00 per unit) in our OP (the "Series A Preferred Units"), all 16,186,525 of the issued and 16,099,443 outstanding 9.00% Series B Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Units (liquidation preference $25.00 per unit) in our OP (the "Series B Preferred Units") and all 80,412 of the issued and outstanding 8.00% Series C Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Units (liquidation preference $25.00 per unit) in our OP (the "Series C Preferred Units") as of December 31, 2025. The Series A Preferred Units have economic terms that are substantially the same as the terms of our 8.50% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock (the "Series A Preferred Stock"), the Series B Preferred Units have economic terms that are substantially the same as the terms of our 9.00% Series B Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock (the "Series B Preferred Stock") and the Series C Preferred Units have economic terms that are substantially the same as the terms of our 8.00% Series C Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock (the "Series C Preferred Stock"). The Series A Preferred Units, the Series B Preferred Units and the Series C Preferred Units rank, as to distributions and upon liquidation, senior to OP Units.

The Company's primary investment objective is to generate attractive, risk-adjusted returns for stockholders over the long term. We intend to achieve this objective primarily by originating, structuring and investing in our target assets. We concentrate on investments in real estate sectors where our senior management team has operating expertise, including in the multifamily, SFR, self-storage and life science sectors predominantly in the top 50 MSAs. Through active portfolio management we seek to take advantage of market opportunities to achieve a superior portfolio risk-mix that delivers attractive total returns.

headings: Our loans and investments expose us to risks similar to and associated with debt-oriented real estate investments generally.
Our real estate investments are subject to risks particular to real property. These risks may result in a reduction or elimination of or return from an investment secured by a particular property.
Commercial real estate-related investments that are secured, directly or indirectly, by real property are subject to delinquency, foreclosure and loss, which could result in losses to us.
Residential loans are subject to increased risks of loss.

Macroeconomic trends including inflation, high interest rates, tariffs, recession, major bank failures or sustained financial market illiquidity may adversely affect our financial condition and results of operations.
Our loans and investments may be subject to fluctuations in interest rates that may not be adequately protected, or protected at all, by our hedging strategies.
Our loans and investments are concentrated in terms of type of interest, geography, asset types and sponsors and may continue to be so in the future.
Prepayment rates may adversely affect the value of our portfolio of assets.
The lack of liquidity in certain of our target assets may adversely affect our business.

Our success depends on the availability of attractive loans and investments and our Manager's ability to identify, structure, consummate, leverage, manage, realize and redeploy returns on our loans and investments.
Any distressed loans or investments we make, or loans and investments that later become distressed, may subject us to losses and other risks relating to bankruptcy proceedings.
We may not have control over certain of our loans and investments.
Loans on properties in development or redevelopment involve a greater risk of loss than conventional mortgage loans.
We may not realize gains or income from our investments.
Real estate valuation is inherently subjective and uncertain.
Some of our portfolio investments may be recorded at fair value not readily available and, as a result, there will be uncertainty as to the value of these investments.
We may experience a decline in the fair value of our assets.
Insurance on loans and real estate securities collateral may not cover all losses.
Acts of violence or war or a prolonged economic slowdown may affect the real estate industry generally and our business, financial condition and results of operations.
paragraphs: You should carefully consider the following risks and other information in this Annual Report in evaluating us and our common stock. Any of the following risks, as well as additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial, could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition or results of operations, and could, in turn, impact the trading price of our common stock.

These disclosures reflect the Company's beliefs and opinions as to factors that could materially and adversely affect the Company and its securities in the future. References to past events are provided by way of example only and are not intended to be a complete listing or a representation as to whether or not such factors have occurred in the past or their likelihood of occurring in the future.

The following is a summary of some of the risks and uncertainties that could materially adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations. You should read this summary together with the more detailed description of each risk factor contained below.

• unfavorable changes in economic conditions and their effects on the real estate industry generally and our operations and financial condition, including inflation, high interest rates, tightening monetary policy or recession, which may limit our ability to access funding and generate returns for our stockholders, as well as the risk we make significant changes to our strategies in a market downturn, or fail to do so;
• risks associated with ownership of real estate, including properties in transition, subjectivity of valuation, environmental matters and lack of liquidity in certain asset classes;

• the exposure of our loans and investments to risks similar to debt-oriented real estate investments generally, including the risk of delinquency, foreclosure and loss in any of our commercial real estate-related investments that are secured, directly or indirectly, by real property;

paragraphs: NexPoint Real Estate Finance, Inc. (the "Company", "we", "our", "NREF") 為一間商業房貸REIT，於2019年6月7日在馬裏蘭州設立，並已選擇依照1986年內部收入法典（Internal Revenue Code）及其修正條文（"Code"）納入REIT稅務類別。本公司專注於發行、結構化及投資於第一優先權房貸貸款（"高優貸款"）、mezzanine貸款、優先股、可轉換債券、多戶住宅不動產及普通股投資，以及多戶住宅及單戶住宅出租（"SFR"）商業房貸擔保證券化（"CMBS證券化"）、承諾書、循環信用融資及股票選擇權，或我們的目標資產。我們主要投資於本公司高階管理團隊具備營運經驗的不動產產業，包括多戶住宅、SFR、自用儲存空間、工業及生命科學產業，主要位於前50大都會統計區（"MSA"）。本公司亦貸款予特殊情況下的重建及開發專案，其中具備強大贊助及明確可見的成本差異點及退出選擇。本公司業務幾乎全部透過NexPoint Real Estate Finance Operating Partnership, L.P.（"OP"）進行，為本公司之營運合夥企業。截至2025年12月31日，本公司持有OP約86.56%的普通有限合夥單位（"OP Units"），代表100%的A類OP Units，且OP持有其三家子合夥企業（ collectively, the "Subsidiary OPs"）所有普通有限合夥單位（"SubOP Units"）（請參見我們合併財務報表之附註13）。

OP 亦直接擁有有限責任公司（the "Mezz LLC"）之全部受益權，透過該公司擁有 mezzanine 貸款組合，如後文進一步說明。NexPoint Real Estate Finance OP GP, LLC（the "OP GP"）為 OP 之唯一普通合夥人。除 OP 單位外，本公司持有我們 OP 之全部 2,000,000 張已發行及流通 8.50% 累計可贖回優先單位（ liquidation preference $25.00 每單位）（the "Series A Preferred Units"）、全部 16,186,525 張已發行及 16,099,443 張流通 9.00% 累計可贖回優先單位（ liquidation preference $25.00 每單位）（the "Series B Preferred Units"）以及全部 80,412 張已發行及流通 8.00% 累計可贖回優先單位（ liquidation preference $25.00 每單位）（the "Series C Preferred Units"）截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日。Series A Preferred Units 之經濟條款與我們 8.50% 累計可贖回優先股（the "Series A Preferred Stock"）之條款幾乎相同，Series B Preferred Units 之經濟條款與我們 9.00% 累計可贖回優先股（the "Series B Preferred Stock"）之條款幾乎相同，Series C Preferred Units 之經濟條款與我們 8.00% 累計可贖回優先股（the "Series C Preferred Stock"）之條款幾乎相同。Series A Preferred Units、Series B Preferred Units 與 Series C Preferred Units 在分派及清算時均優先於 OP 單位。
本公司主要投資目標為為股東在長遠期間產生有吸引力、風險調整後之回報。我們意圖透過發行、結構化及投資於目標資產來達成此目標。我們集中投資於本公司高階管理團隊具備營運經驗的不動產產業，包括多戶住宅、SFR、自用儲存空間及生命科學產業，主要位於前50大都會統計區（MSA）。透過積極的資產管理，我們尋求利用市場機會，以達成優越的資產風險組合，並產生有吸引力的總回報。

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
我們的貸款及投資會使我們面臨與以債務為導向的不動產投資一般相關的風險。
我們的不動產投資會面臨與實體不動產相關的特定風險。這些風險可能導致投資所產生的回報減少或完全消失。
以實體不動產直接或間接作為擔保的商業不動產相關投資，會面臨逾期、拍賣及損失的風險，這可能會導致我們產生損失。
住宅貸款會面臨更高的損失風險。
總體經濟趨勢包括通貨膨脹、高利率、關稅、經濟衰退、大型銀行破產或持續的財務市場流動性不足，可能會對我們的財務狀況及營運成果產生不利影響。
我們的貸款及投資可能面臨利率波動的風險，而這些風險可能無法被我們的避險策略充分保護，甚至完全未受保護。
本公司之貸款及投資集中於利息類型、地理區域、資產類型及發起人，未來可能持續如此。
預付率可能不利於本公司資產組合之價值。
我們部分目標資產之流動性不足，可能不利於本公司業務。
本公司之成功取決於吸引人的貸款及投資之可得性，以及本公司管理人識別、結構、完成、利用、管理、實現及重新配置貸款及投資回報之能力。
本公司所進行之任何困境貸款或投資，或後續成為困境之貸款及投資，可能使本公司面臨虧損及其他與破產程序相關之風險。
本公司可能無法對部分貸款及投資行使控制權。
開發中或重建中之不動產貸款涉及較高之損失風險，較傳統房貸為高。
本公司可能無法從投資中實現獲利或收入。
不動產評價本質上具有主觀性且不確定性。
我們部分投資組合投資可能以非即時可取得之公允價值計入，因此這些投資之價值將存在不確定性。
我們可能面臨資產公允價值下降的情況。
貸款及不動產證券擔保之保險可能無法涵蓋所有損失。
暴力事件或戰爭或長時間經濟減速可能影響不動產業務整體及我們之業務、財務狀況與營運成果。

paragraphs: 您應仔細考量本年度報告中下列風險及其他資訊，以評估本公司及其普通股。任何下列風險，以及目前未為本公司所知或本公司認為不重要之其他風險與不確定性，均可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況或營運成果造成重大且不利之影響，進而影響本公司普通股之交易價格。
本項揭露反映本公司對可能對本公司及其證券未來造成重大且不利影響之因素之信念與意見。提及過去事件僅為示例，並非完整列出或表示這些因素是否已發生於過去，或其未來發生之可能性。
下列為可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大且不利影響之風險與不確定性之總結。您應配合下列各風險因素之詳細說明，一併閱讀此總結。
• 不利之經濟條件變動及其對房地產業務整體與本公司業務及財務狀況之影響，包括通貨膨脹、高利率、貨幣政策收緊或經濟衰退，可能限制本公司取得資金及為股東產生報酬之能力，以及本公司在市場低迷時可能做出重大策略變動，或未能做出變動之風險；
• 擁有不動產之風險，包括處於轉型階段之不動產、評價主觀性、環境問題及特定資產類別之流動性不足；
• 本公司貸款與投資所面臨之風險，與一般以債務為導向之不動產投資相似，包括任何本公司商業不動產相關投資可能產生之逾期、拍賣及損失風險，該等投資可能直接或間接以不動產為擔保。
